entities.summary: Major General Yusif Akhundzade is a prestigious Azerbaijani military conductor and director. Akhundzade was the current Senior Military Director of the Military Band Service of the Armed Forces of Azerbaijan. He also served concurrently as the director of the Central Band of the Ministry of Defense of Azerbaijan, a position he held from 1992-2024.
